titleZh: 记住一个单词，从重新想起它开始

cet4.title: Remembering Words Through Meaningful Practice
cet4.summary: 看着词表觉得熟悉，并不保证日后能回忆。有效的词汇练习需要隐藏答案，让学习者真实尝试提取记忆。

paragraphs.text: A learner looks at a list of words and feels that every item is familiar. The next day, the same words are difficult to recall in an article. Familiarity can be misleading. Seeing an answer on a page is different from finding it in memory. A useful vocabulary routine therefore includes moments when the meaning is hidden and the learner makes an honest attempt to remember it.
paragraphs.translation: 看着词表觉得熟悉，并不保证日后能回忆。有效的词汇练习需要隐藏答案，让学习者真实尝试提取记忆。

paragraphs.text: Context can make this practice more meaningful. A word collected from an article comes with a sentence, a topic and a reason for reading it. Keeping that sentence helps the learner understand how the word was used. However, the sentence should not become the only clue available. Meeting the word in another passage can show whether its meaning has become flexible enough to travel beyond the original example.
paragraphs.translation: 阅读中的词带有原句、话题和学习目的，保存语境有助于理解用法。但也应在其他文章中遇到它，检查是否依赖单一线索。

paragraphs.text: Reviewing also needs a sensible rhythm. Repeating a difficult word immediately can help correct a mistake, but returning to it later provides another kind of challenge. A review system can arrange future practice according to the learner's response. Accurate feedback is important: choosing the easiest rating simply to finish faster gives the system a false picture. Forgetting is information that helps guide the next step.
paragraphs.translation: 立即重复可以纠错，间隔后的回忆提供另一种挑战。复习系统根据反馈安排练习，真实报告遗忘能帮助系统判断。

paragraphs.text: Progress should be understood over time. Collecting a hundred words is an action, not proof that a hundred meanings can be recalled. A learner can ask whether old articles now feel easier and whether familiar words are recognised in new contexts. The aim is useful reading, not a growing collection of coloured cards. A smaller group of well-practised words can contribute more than a large list that is never revisited.
paragraphs.translation: 收藏数量并不等于掌握数量。应关注旧文是否更易理解、能否在新语境识别词义，目标是实际阅读能力而非卡片堆积。

paragraphs.text: A practical starting point is to choose a daily number that can be maintained. Reviewing a few words carefully leaves room for reading, where vocabulary gains its purpose. If the review list becomes too large, reducing new additions can help. A routine should support attention to meaning rather than create an endless race against a growing queue.
paragraphs.translation: 设定可持续的每日数量，留出阅读时间。积压变多时减少新增，能让复习继续围绕词义，而非追赶不断增长的队列。

questions.prompt: Why can a visible word list create misleading confidence?
options: Every displayed translation has several errors.
Looking at words permanently prevents learning.
All familiar words have exactly the same meaning.
Seeing an answer is different from recalling it independently.
questions.explanation: 熟悉感不等于独立提取能力。

questions.prompt: Why should a saved word include its original sentence?
options: It removes the value of future encounters.
It makes every review unnecessary.
The sentence helps explain how the word was used.
It guarantees that the word has only one meaning.
questions.explanation: 原句帮助理解具体用法，但仍需要新语境。

questions.prompt: Why should review feedback be honest?
options: Feedback has no relationship to future practice.
Scheduling depends on the learner’s actual recall.
The easiest rating always leads to the best learning.
Guessing correctly proves permanent mastery.
questions.explanation: 反馈为之后的复习安排提供依据。

options: As information about what needs more attention.
As proof that further practice is impossible.
As a reason to remove all difficult words forever.
As an achievement identical to recalling correctly.
questions.explanation: 遗忘可以帮助定位需要巩固的内容。

questions.prompt: What is the ultimate goal of the vocabulary routine?
options: Collecting the greatest possible number of cards.
Making every progress chart look perfect.
Avoiding every encounter with unfamiliar language.
Reading with better understanding.
questions.explanation: 词汇学习最终服务于真实阅读理解。

cet6.title: Vocabulary Learning Beyond the Appearance of Familiarity
cet6.summary: 看着词表觉得熟悉，并不保证日后能回忆。有效的词汇练习需要隐藏答案，让学习者真实尝试提取记忆。

paragraphs.text: Vocabulary study can create an impression of progress without producing an equivalent improvement in retrieval. When both a word and its translation remain visible, their connection may feel obvious. That feeling, however, does not establish that the meaning will be available during later reading. Distinguishing recognition of a displayed answer from independent recall is therefore essential. A useful practice routine creates opportunities to discover what can be retrieved when the immediate support has been removed.
paragraphs.translation: 同时看到词与译文会产生熟悉感，但这不代表之后能独立回忆。词汇学习应区分看到答案后的识别与移除支持后的提取。

paragraphs.text: Learning vocabulary through reading offers a valuable starting point because a word appears within a meaningful situation. The surrounding sentence can clarify its grammatical role, relevant meaning and relationship to other expressions. Saving that context makes a personal collection more informative than an isolated translation alone. Nevertheless, learning should not become dependent on one familiar sentence. Further encounters are needed to reveal whether the learner can interpret the same word when the topic, wording or supporting clues have changed.
paragraphs.translation: 阅读语境能解释语法角色、具体词义与搭配关系，但不应依赖唯一原句。其他话题与线索下的再次遇见，可检验灵活理解。

paragraphs.text: The timing of those encounters also matters. Immediate repetition can help establish a correction, whereas later retrieval asks whether the connection remains available after an interval. A scheduling system can use the learner's feedback to arrange subsequent reviews. Its decisions are only as informative as the responses on which they are based. Reporting effortless recall after guessing or revealing an answer too early confuses an impression of success with evidence that the task was actually completed.
paragraphs.translation: 立即重复与延后提取承担不同作用。调度系统依赖真实反馈，猜中或先揭示答案后自评轻松，会扭曲其依据。

paragraphs.text: This distinction suggests a different way to interpret mistakes. An unsuccessful attempt is not simply a mark against the learner; it identifies a connection that requires further attention. The learner can inspect the relevant sentence, clarify the intended meaning and attempt retrieval again at an appropriate time. At the same time, no single successful response should be treated as permanent mastery. Memory changes with experience, and a useful system continues to adapt rather than assigning an irreversible label after one test.
paragraphs.translation: 错误能指出需要注意的连接，不只是负面评价。一次正确也不代表永久掌握，复习应随着记忆变化持续调整。

paragraphs.text: The broader purpose remains the ability to read with understanding. Counts of saved words, completed cards or consecutive days can describe behaviour, but they should not replace that objective. Returning to an older article and encountering familiar vocabulary in unfamiliar material offer additional perspectives on progress. A sustainable collection is one that the learner can actually revisit. Its value lies in meanings that become available when needed, not in the visual satisfaction of accumulating an ever larger inventory of items.
paragraphs.translation: 最终目标是阅读理解。收藏和打卡记录反映行为，却不能替代真实能力；能持续重温的词集，比不断膨胀的库存更有价值。

paragraphs.text: Workload provides a final practical consideration. Adding new words faster than they can be revisited creates a queue that may eventually discourage participation. A manageable daily target leaves time for reading and for careful responses during review. When the queue grows, reducing new additions can restore balance without treating the change as failure. The system should remain a support for meaningful practice, with its demands adjusted to the learner’s available time and the value of continued engagement.
paragraphs.translation: 新增速度过快会形成令人退缩的积压。可管理的目标应为阅读和认真回忆留出时间，必要时减少新增以恢复平衡。
